title: Sample idea: a vendor invoice approval workflow
idea: Route every vendor invoice through an online approval workflow instead of email.

rounds.name: Opening positions
notes: Late invoices cost us early-payment discounts every month.
Our suppliers send paper and PDFs. I think the workflow should accept whatever they send, not force a portal.
Who approves what? Without limits, everything waits on the CFO.
Approvals by the same person who ordered the goods invite fraud.
Match each invoice to its purchase order and most approve themselves.
rounds.card: An approval workflow that accepts any invoice format, matches it to a purchase order, and routes by amount.
credits: matches it to a purchase order

rounds.name: Pushback and concessions
notes: Agreed, no portal. We scan email and paper into it.
Invoices that match the PO within 2 percent auto-approve under $5,000.
Auto-approve is fine, but never to a new vendor or a changed bank account.
Right. New vendors and bank changes always need two people.
Set approval limits by amount: manager, then director, then CFO.
rounds.card: Invoices in any format are matched to a PO; matches under $5,000 auto-approve, larger ones route by amount, and new vendors or bank changes need two approvers.
credits: new vendors or bank changes need two approvers

rounds.name: Best version
notes: Report discounts captured and days-to-pay monthly, or we won't know it worked.
Clear limits and a fraud stop. Good craftsmanship.
Vendors get paid sooner, finance spends less time chasing. Everybody wins.
rounds.card: Any-format invoices matched to POs, auto-approval under $5,000, tiered limits above, two approvers for new vendors or bank changes, and monthly results.

gates.finding: Scanning and PO data already exist.
Bank detail changes are a known fraud route.
gates.change: Confirm any bank change by phone to a known number.

gates.finding: Vendors keep sending invoices their way.

final: Vendor invoices arrive however vendors send them and are matched to purchase orders. Matches within 2 percent under $5,000 approve automatically, larger ones go to manager, director or CFO by amount, and any new vendor or bank change needs two approvers plus a phone check to a known number. Discounts captured and days-to-pay are reported monthly.
changed: No vendor portal, any format accepted
Two approvers for new vendors and bank changes
dissent: The Manufacturer worries small suppliers will be confused by automated remittance emails.
final_credits: Matches within 2 percent under $5,000 approve automatically
manager, director or CFO by amount
any new vendor or bank change needs two approvers
plus a phone check to a known number
Discounts captured and days-to-pay are reported monthly
